summary:
# [1.3.7] - 2026-11-08

Release 1.3.7. On the phone's floor plan, and on the Route picker's, a selected TV shows a ring and a tick and only
the one just tapped carries its name, so a crowd of selected TVs stays readable.

### Fixed

- **Selected TVs' names piled up on the phone's plan.** Every selected dot carried its name, so a cluster of
  selected TVs hid its neighbours' dots and names under each other. A selected dot now shows a ring and a tick,
  only the TV just tapped carries its name, and the strip under the plan (or the picker's list) names them all.
